Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the use of leaf blowers by state agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the use of leaf blowers by stateagencies; and amending RCW 43.19.003 and 43.19.125.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.19.003 and 2011 1st sp.s. c 43 s 102 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this chapterunless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Department" means the department of enterprise services. (2) "Director" means the director of enterprise services. (3) "Leaf blower" means any portable machine powered by a gasolineengine used to blow leaves, dirt, and other debris off sidewalks,driveways, lawns, or other surfaces. (4) "State agency" means any office, department, division, bureau,board, commission, or other agency of the state of Washington.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.19.125 and 2011 1st sp.s. c 43 s 204 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) The director of enterprise services shall have custody andcontrol of the capitol buildings and grounds, supervise and direct p. 1 SB 6342proper care, heating, lighting and repairing thereof, and designaterooms in the capitol buildings to be occupied by various stateofficials. (b) In addition to the powers and duties as provided under RCW43.19.005, the director shall ensure the maintenance and care ofgrounds under the control of state agencies do not include the use ofleaf blowers. (2) During the 20072009 biennium, responsibility for developmentof the "Wheeler block" on the capitol campus as authorized in section6013, chapter 520, Laws of 2007 shall be transferred from thedepartment of general administration to the department of informationservices. (3) State agencies are prohibited from using leaf blowers.
